name: SES-imagotag Societe Anonyme
summary: SES-imagotag Société Anonyme engages in the installation and maintenance of electronic shelf labels for the retail industry worldwide. The company offers Internet of Things (IoT) and hardware products, which include electronic shelf labels, vusion rail, fixtures and accessories, infrastructure, WiFi integrations, and fashion tags. It also provides cloud platform solutions comprising retail IoT hub, store automation, shelf efficiency, shopper engagement, and store analytics. The company was formerly known as Store Electronic Systems Société Anonyme and changed its name to SES-imagotag Société Anonyme in January 2016. SES-imagotag Société Anonyme was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Nanterre, France.
